an4.237:2.1: Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ?
an4.237:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco savyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti . . . pe . . . [232.2]. Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ kaṇhavipākaṃ. 3.
an4.237:3.1: Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ?
an4.237:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco avyāpajjhaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkharoti . . . pe . . . [232.3]. Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ sukkaṃ sukkavipākaṃ. 4.
an4.237:4.1: Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhasukkhaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ?
an4.237:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco savyāpajjham pi avyāpajjham pi . . . pe . . . [232. 4] Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhasukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ. 5.
an4.237:5.1: Katamañ ca bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhamasukkaṃ akaṇha-asukkavipākaṃ kammaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati.
an4.237:5.3: Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhamasukkaṃ . . . saṃvattati.
an4.237:5.4: Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri kammāni mayā . . . paveditānīti. 236. 1.
